conditions.description: Classic CartPole dynamics, episodes capped at 200 steps. States discretised into 6 pole-angle bins and 6 angular-velocity bins. Tabular Q-learning with discount 0.99. Epsilon-greedy exploration with decay factor 0.99 per episode floored at 0.05. Learning rate 0.1. Q-values initialised to zero. Rewards unnormalised. Train 400 episodes, evaluate greedy policy for 20 episodes, average over 10 random seeds.

quote: We show that a small tabular Q-learner balances CartPole for a mean of 17.3 steps, and that its worst seed still balances for 9.1.
